items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.summary: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
items.why_relevant: 中美俄峰会，地缘核裁军

confirmed_facts.text: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says - Published Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says - Published Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said.

confirmed_facts.text: The historic meeting between the respective leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The historic meeting between the respective leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters.

confirmed_facts.text: "The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: "The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said.

confirmed_facts.text: It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine.

confirmed_facts.text: Russia has confirmed the meeting.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Russia has confirmed the meeting.

confirmed_facts.text: No agreement was expected to follow the talks, an unnamed, senior US official said, according to news agencies AP and Reuters.

items.title: Researchers allege DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained using banned Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
items.summary: Researchers pinpoint that DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained on export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell chips — statistical analysis on model weights reveals high correlation to Nvidia hardware

confirmed_facts.text: Researchers allege DeepSeek, Kimi, and other Chinese AI models were trained using banned Nvidia Blackwell GPUs — Researchers use new GPU 'fingerprinting' technique to identify the GPUs used to train open models A clever yet simple way to establish correlation.

items.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
items.summary: The US government is trying to find out whether the chaos was caused by "incompetence" or faulty equipment.
items.why_relevant: 美国航班停摆，基建信号

confirmed_facts.text: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says - Published A nationwide US ground stop that caused thousands of flight cancellations was caused by an issue following a copper wire upgrade, Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says - Published A nationwide US ground stop that caused thousands of flight cancellations was caused by an issue following a copper wire upgrade, Transport Secretary Sean Duffy said.

confirmed_facts.text: Duffy told a news conference that the government was trying to find out whether the problem was caused by "incompetence" on the part of the company doing the upgrades, or faulty equipment.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Duffy told a news conference that the government was trying to find out whether the problem was caused by "incompetence" on the part of the company doing the upgrades, or faulty equipment.

confirmed_facts.text: The US government does not believe it was as a result of a cyber-attack, although an investigation is still under way, Duffy said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The US government does not believe it was as a result of a cyber-attack, although an investigation is still under way, Duffy said.

confirmed_facts.text: Friday's suspension was the longest such incident since the 11 September 2001 attacks on the US and the disruption is expected to last for days.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Friday's suspension was the longest such incident since the 11 September 2001 attacks on the US and the disruption is expected to last for days.

confirmed_facts.text: Maintenance was being carried out to switch from copper wire to fibre by a contractor called L3Harris, a technology provider company, Duffy said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Maintenance was being carried out to switch from copper wire to fibre by a contractor called L3Harris, a technology provider company, Duffy said.

confirmed_facts.text: "It was such an old wire that it was being discontinued," he said.

confirmed_facts.text: The Microsoft outage could be a disaster for the Australian economy that forces some small businesses to close, with costs expected to run into the billions of dollars, experts have warned.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The Microsoft outage could be a disaster for the Australian economy that forces some small businesses to close, with costs expected to run into the billions of dollars, experts have warned.

confirmed_facts.text: The US software company has said it is “deeply sorry” for a widespread outage that caused disruption to millions of users, organisations and businesses across the globe – and that it has “addressed the underlying issue”.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The US software company has said it is “deeply sorry” for a widespread outage that caused disruption to millions of users, organisations and businesses across the globe – and that it has “addressed the underlying issue”.

confirmed_facts.text: The company said the outage was a “technical issue” not related to cyber-attacks or AI agents, and that it continued to gradually restore services.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The company said the outage was a “technical issue” not related to cyber-attacks or AI agents, and that it continued to gradually restore services.

confirmed_facts.text: Experts have said the outage exposes “Australia’s reliance on foreign technology” and that people unable to be paid, send an invoice, or access government services “are entitled to be worried”.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Experts have said the outage exposes “Australia’s reliance on foreign technology” and that people unable to be paid, send an invoice, or access government services “are entitled to be worried”.
